probes.name: ownsSessionScopedState lets a teammate's own loop through
probes.comment: Drop the teammate clause and the two session-owned producers go silent for a teammate — the regression the field exists to prevent.

probes.name: date_change gate sits BEFORE the one-shot read
probes.comment: Removing it is the only mutation that shows the ordering: a gate placed after the read would return [] for the child and still have recorded today's date, so the parent would never be told the day changed.
